text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Carrotman makes a solemn promise 
to the Hachimi Princess!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm. And then, and then? What happens 
to Honey Pudding-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
N-o-p-e! Hachimi Princess! Bono, you 
always turn everything into food talk!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is so good!? What's with these 
carrot chips?! "Authentic Carrot 
Flavor"...?!'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you like this flavor too, 
Biko-chan? Apparently it's a new series 
that just came out last week~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a new series! Next time you go buy 
some, I'll come along... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, no! We're talking about Carrotman 
right now. I really want you to watch next 
week's episode with me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure thing~! In that case, I'll bake 
some donuts for a morning snack before the 
day arrives♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! Then I want carrot flavor, chocolate 
flavor, and strawberry flavor! And then...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, waaaah—! We're talking about sweets 
again—!? Jeez~~!
